blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 被炉绘图舱
blueprints.description: 她的房间中央，被炉上架着绘图板与显示器，她整个人缩在被炉里只露出脑袋和拿笔的手，耳机夹着碎发；屏幕上是从未示人的新插画，房间灯光全关只剩屏幕光。

blueprints.promptProse: Inside her dark bedroom, Sagiri works from a warm kotatsu almost entirely hidden by its quilt, only her head and drawing hand visible. Loose silver strands catch under her headset as the stylus follows a new landscape illustration on the tablet. Monitor light illuminates her concentrated blue eyes, with brushes and cables arranged across the low tabletop in a close horizontal view.

blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 直播开场前的招呼练习

blueprints.action: 朝桌上摄像头练习挥手，被自己的认真模样逗笑。
blueprints.promptProse: Sagiri practices a small wave toward the desk webcam before her drawing stream begins. Her fully zipped mint fleece hoodie and navy full-length lounge trousers cover the seated figure, with both knees clearly enclosed in fabric. A little bear plush sits firmly beside the keyboard. She glances down and smiles at her overly serious rehearsal, silver hair softly lit by the front desk lamp. Show the drawing tablet, chair and surrounding room continuously around this ordinary preparation moment.

blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 第一次自己出门买书

A cap and plain mask frame her determined blue eyes, with her zipped pink hoodie and blue jeans neatly arranged. Blurred street colors stay behind her tense shoulders; the medium view catches one deep breath, the doorway and the first forward step.

blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 夏日祭的和服

blueprints.promptProse: Beside a goldfish stall, Sagiri stares in dismay at her torn paper scoop, holding back a long yukata sleeve with the other hand. Her pale blue floral yukata is securely wrapped with a pink obi. Lantern reflections ripple around the little fish as she stamps one sandal lightly, silver hair bouncing with the entirely unhidden frustration of a festival game.

blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 取材海滩的防晒武装
blueprints.description: 海边取材，她被遮阳帽、防晒袖套、大墨镜全副武装到只剩一小截手指握着速写本；面对大海认真速写的样子与其说是度假不如说是出任务。

blueprints.promptProse: A broad sunhat and large sunglasses shade Sagiri as she sketches the coastline from beneath a beach umbrella. Her long-sleeved sun jacket and full-length trousers cover her completely, only fingertips visible around the sketchbook and pencil. Blue waves and a pale horizon fill the distance, while her earnest forward lean makes this look like a field assignment rather than a holiday.

blueprints.title: 和泉纱雾 · 新年参拜的许愿
blueprints.description: 冬装大衣围巾，她在神社绘马上认真写下「今年也要画出更好的画」，挂上去时垫着脚努力够高处；呼出的白气与晨光里，她的表情是罕见的、毫无阴霾的笑。
blueprints.action: 踮脚把画着心愿的绘马挂高，迎着晨光露出笑容。
blueprints.promptProse: At a shrine on New Year morning, Sagiri stretches onto her toes to hang a wooden wish plaque among the others. Her cream coat and pink scarf frame a rare, carefree smile, silver hair lifting in the cold breeze. White breath glows in the sunlight while the medium view follows her raised hands and the little illustration she drew on the plaque.
